note: User-visible strings added by ADR new-primitives-polyhedra-text (phase 2: Torus, Triangular prism, Advanced shapes, Letters, numbers & symbols). dom-baseline.mjs accepts exactly these additions to the aab9865 string baseline; anything else new, or any removal, still fails. ADR-0001 W0 (3.0 v3-foundation): "tristancad.autosave.v3" is the internal localStorage key of the dual-key autosave (§2.2, Q14), not UI text. W0 mode bar and dock (ADR-0001 §2.3, round-2 ruling 1): "Rotate" and "Mirror" are the reserved, hidden mode-bar buttons; "Export" is the renamed dock button. "Export STL" leaves the string table at the W0 re-baseline (strings-baseline.json --update after Sean's approval). ADR-0001 F6 (round-chamfer-dropdown): "Edge ▾" is the mode-bar label of the Round button (set by touch-tools.mjs at startup; Master Chief ruling 1, 2026-10-17, replaces "Round ▾"), "Edge" its word; "Round"/"Chamfer" are the Edge ▾ chooser items; the other Chamfer strings are the Chamfer variants of the Round-mode hint, the Radius/Distance action button, the exact-value sheet and its toast, and the engine's chamfer error (cad-solid.mjs). The template-literal Chamfer texts (drag readout, sheet intro) are covered by the DOM snapshots. Architect F6 ruling, approved 2026-10-17: both edge-sheet intros say "in Edge mode" instead of "in Round mode"; their fixed sentences are listed here (the template literals themselves are not extracted). ADR-0001 strings roll-forward (Architect ruling 12:05 AM CT Oct 18): the 11 F6 strings that the extractor sees ("Apply chamfer", "Chamfer", "Chamfer applied.", "Chamfer distance · ", "Chamfer selected edges", "Distance", "Edge taps: 1 edge · 2 face perimeter · 3 all edges · drag to chamfer", "Edge ▾", "Enter a non-negative distance.", "Remove selected chamfers", "That chamfer is too large or conflicts with another edge. Reduce the distance.") moved into strings-baseline.json of perf-baseline-release-3.0-6892eb7 (447 strings = v3-foundation 436 + these 11) and were removed from this list. F6's "Edge" and the two "in Edge mode" sentences stay listed: they are approved but not extracted (template literals / not used alone), so they cannot be part of the generated baseline. Architect strings-additions-cleanup (test-only follow-up): the 31 redundant entries (new-primitives, W0, autosave key, etc.) that are already present exactly in perf-baseline-release-3.0-6892eb7/strings-baseline.json (447 strings) were removed after verification. The three remaining entries below are each approved+merged, not extractable. F1b ruling 1 (UI round 1): "Esc" is the key name in a command tooltip such as "Close panel (Esc)", the spelling the approved help table already uses. ADR-0001 approved-dom-areas: "removals" lists approved removals {string, approval}; a baseline string missing from the extracted set passes only if listed here, and the entry is dropped when the baseline rolls forward. The extractor now skips // and /* */ comments; the only string that drops out (release-3.0 116253c and aabf6ea) is comment-only text at web/perf-flags.mjs:72, listed under "extractorCorrections" {string, reason, source} (an extractor correction, not an approved removal; QA confirms it is not rendered anywhere at runtime). A "strings" entry may also be a runtime text {text, runtime:true, source:"file:line", approval}: the exact rendered text of a title the extractor cannot see; no templates or patterns. ADR-0001 F1a (keyboard-shortcuts): the help-sheet Keyboard shortcuts rows and the desktop pill text are the Sean-approved help text (2026-10-17 ~16:10 CT batch; the table grows with the features, round-2 ruling 2, so F1a ships only the rows of commands that exist, and "F Round" was the approved "F Round ▾ (press F again for Chamfer)" row before F6). The old pill string leaves the table at the W0 re-baseline, like "Export STL". Not UI text: "Delete", "Backspace", "Home", "Dead" and "Unidentified" are KeyboardEvent.key names in commands.mjs ("Delete" and "Duplicate" are also registry labels, the existing Edit-sheet button labels); "mode:…" and "view:…" are registry command ids. F1a help-row ruling (approved by First Sergeant via the Architect, 2026-10-18 overnight; goes in the final shortcut table for Master Chief's sign-off): the F row reads "F Edge (Round/Chamfer)" (no ▾), matching the "Edge (F)" tooltip. The old "F Round" entry is dropped (unused since the F Edge (Round/Chamfer) row; QA note at d7513fb). ADR-0001 F7 (glyph-emboss-bevel), Architect F7 rulings 1/4/5: the Edit-glyph finish field labels "Bevel", "Round/Chamfer", "Plate", "Margin", "Engrave" (drafts, in the approval batch); the Engrave validation "Engrave needs a plate thicker than 1 mm."; the half-size bevel notice, a template literal in main.mjs (value through units.mjs fmtLen/unitLabel), listed here as "Bevel reduced to {value} {unit} on '{char}'"; and the ADR bevel error template "Bevel not possible on '{char}' at this size" (cad-solid.mjs). Template literals are not extracted.
